name: ACL RD-TEC
description: A dataset for benchmarking terminology extraction and classification in computational linguistics.
reputation: A well-known dataset in computational-linguistics terminology extraction research, widely used for evaluating term extraction and classification approaches in the community.
notes: Relatively small and domain-specific (ACL papers), primarily an information-extraction (non-LLM-specific) benchmark; potential saturation on simple models and limited domain diversity.
